registry: Companion, companion chat, full chat, storage, archive, memory, voice binding and Live2D selection consume the companion registry projection

adapter: Browser mouth, blink, focus, emotions, hit zones, interactions, entrance, leave and overlay reset consume a compiled avatar profile

behavior: Character switches preserve drafts and per-character outfits, discard stale model work and release the previous native model
Native visibility, power and bounds events keep their existing interruption and latest-state guards
